notes: The data-access criterion of the default harness was replaced. Arrow has no server-side data layer and no rows to own, so the criterion became the theme discipline: every color comes from a token in packages/theme.
The layer list is the Arrow layer list. The workspace packages under packages/ may not import the Tauri API and may not import the desktop app; the desktop app owns every Tauri call.
Raise minimumCriteria when a criterion is added. Never lower it to make the score pass.

minimumProofs is the floor on the proof set, and it lives here so the scorer and the prover cannot disagree about it. Raise it when a proof case is added. Never lower it to make the score pass, and never empty the proof set: a proof run that proves nothing fails.
The scorer counts the coverage check separately from the criteria, so a score of 10/10 means ten criteria passed.
